rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Grandiflora.
Exhibition name: Oh Happy Day ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 1999).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2015 as 'Oh Happy Day'.
rows.Bloom: Golden-yellow, apricot shading, pink reverse. Mild fragrance. 50 to 55 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Semi-glossy, medium green, leathery foliage. 7 leaflets.

Height: up to 47" (up to 120cm). Width: up to 28" (up to 70cm).
